gate.title: XP comes from being useful
gate.body: Learning earns it, and so does work of yours that someone liked, an Owner endorsed, or someone used. Publishing on its own earns nothing — otherwise the fastest way up would be to post constantly, and the Spaces would fill with noise.
gate.whoCounts: Likes from people who have not learned anything in that Space still count toward the contribution, but grant no XP. You cannot like your own work.

learning.label: Learning
learning.meaning: Finishing Lessons and practice in any Space.

liked.label: Liked by someone
liked.meaning: Someone found a contribution of yours useful.

endorsed.label: Endorsed by an Owner
endorsed.meaning: An Owner marked your work as worth trusting.

used.label: Used by someone
used.meaning: Someone completed a practice set you wrote.

milestone.label: Milestone
milestone.meaning: Your first contribution — once ever, not once per Space.

moments.name: Moments
moments.title: The firsts
moments.lede: The first time each thing happened to you here. Nothing on this page is a score, and there is nothing to collect — these are just the days something changed.
moments.empty: Nothing yet. Finish a Lesson and the first one lands here.

history.legend: A filled square is a day you studied. Nothing here counts toward XP or your Rank.
